read_only.title: This workspace is read-only
read_only.owner_intro: Your account is over its plan's limits:

reasons.workspaces_per_user: It owns more workspaces than the plan includes.
reasons.projects_per_workspace: A workspace has more projects than the plan includes.
reasons.items_per_project: A project has more items than the plan includes.
reasons.storage_bytes_per_workspace: A workspace uses more storage than the plan includes.
reasons.editors_per_account: It has more editors than the plan includes.

read_only.owner_action: Upgrade your plan, or delete what you no longer need. Editing comes back as soon as the account is within its limits.
read_only.member: Contact its owner, {owner}, to edit it again.
